name: Shotcut
tagline: A free, open source, cross-platform video editor.
description: Shotcut is a free, open source, cross-platform video editor.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/shotcut:26.9.27@sha256:2b408ec9f1e32a4a73f85d7ecec618bd42f1d3dd610b69614c1b0b3346a8c789
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
